106	// Snapshot returns a point-in-time snapshot of all managed processes.
107	func (m *Manager) Snapshot() []monitor.BackendStatus {
108		m.mu.RLock()
109		defer m.mu.RUnlock()
110	
111		result := make([]monitor.BackendStatus, 0, len(m.procs))
112		for _, ps := range m.procs {
113			ps.mu.Lock()
114			pid := 0
115			if ps.proc != nil && ps.proc.Process != nil {
116				pid = ps.proc.Process.Pid
117			}
118			status := monitor.BackendStatus{
119				Name:      ps.modelName,
120				Model:     ps.modelName,
121				Port:      ps.port,
122				PID:       pid,
123				Loaded:    ps.state == stateLoaded,
124				Status:    ps.state.String(),
125				StartedAt: ps.startedAt,
126				Restarts:  ps.restarts,
127			}
128			ps.mu.Unlock()
129			result = append(result, status)
130		}
131		return result
132	}

167	// Start launches supervisor goroutines for all warmup models.
168	// It returns immediately; health checks happen asynchronously.
169	func (m *Manager) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
170		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
171		m.ctx = ctx
172		m.cancel = cancel
173	
174		for _, modelName := range m.cfg.Warmup {
175			params, ok := m.cfg.MatchModel(modelName)
176			if !ok {
177				cancel()
178				return fmt.Errorf("warmup model %q does not match any pattern", modelName)
179			}
180			if err := m.startSupervisor(modelName, params, true); err != nil {
181				cancel()
182				return err
183			}
184		}
185		return nil
186	}

188	// startSupervisor creates a procState and launches the supervisor goroutine.
189	// Must NOT hold m.mu.
190	func (m *Manager) startSupervisor(modelName string, params config.ModelParams, isWarmup bool) error {
191		modelCtx, modelCancel := context.WithCancel(m.ctx)
192		ps := &procState{
193			modelName: modelName,
194			params:    params,
195			state:     stateLoading,
196			ready:     make(chan struct{}),
197			cancel:    modelCancel,
198			isWarmup:  isWarmup,
199		}
200	
201		m.mu.Lock()
202		m.procs[modelName] = ps
203		m.mu.Unlock()
204	
205		m.wg.Add(1)
206		ps.wg.Add(1)
207		go m.supervise(modelCtx, modelName)
208		return nil
209	}

233	// Addr returns the base URL for a healthy model's process.
234	func (m *Manager) Addr(name string) (string, bool) {
235		m.mu.RLock()
236		ps, ok := m.procs[name]
237		m.mu.RUnlock()
238		if !ok {
239			return "", false
240		}
241		ps.mu.Lock()
242		defer ps.mu.Unlock()

249	// LoadOrGet returns the address of the named model, loading it on demand if
250	// necessary. Concurrent calls for the same unloaded model coalesce — one
251	// process starts and all waiters get the address when it becomes healthy.
252	//
253	// The caller must call the returned release function (typically via defer) when
254	// the proxied request completes. This decrements the in-flight counter and
255	// allows the model to be evicted once idle.
256	//
257	// Errors:
258	//   - context.Canceled / context.DeadlineExceeded: caller's context expired
259	//   - "model is shutting down": model is being drained
260	//   - "at capacity …": max_models reached with all models in use
261	//   - "model … load failed: …": llama-server failed to start or become healthy
262	func (m *Manager) LoadOrGet(ctx context.Context, modelName string, params config.ModelParams) (addr string, release func(), err error) {
263		noop := func() {}
264	
265		m.mu.Lock()
266	
267		if ps, ok := m.procs[modelName]; ok {
268			ps.mu.Lock()
269			state := ps.state
270			ready := ps.ready
271			port := ps.port
272			ps.mu.Unlock()
273	
274			switch state {
275			case stateLoaded:
276				ps.inflight.Add(1)
277				ps.mu.Lock()
278				ps.lastUsed = time.Now()
279				ps.mu.Unlock()
280				m.mu.Unlock()
281				return fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d", port), func() { ps.inflight.Add(-1) }, nil
282	
283			case stateLoading:
284				// Another goroutine is already loading this model. Wait for it.
285				m.mu.Unlock()
286				select {
287				case <-ready:
288				case <-ctx.Done():
289					return "", noop, ctx.Err()
290				}
291				return m.checkLoaded(modelName)
292	
293			case stateUnloading:
294				m.mu.Unlock()
295				return "", noop, fmt.Errorf("model %q is shutting down", modelName)
296	
297			case stateIdle:
298				// Stale failed entry; clean up and reload.
299				delete(m.procs, modelName)
300			}
301		}
302	
303		// Model not present (or was idle): check capacity, evict if needed, then load.
304		// evictIfNeeded may release and re-acquire m.mu internally.
305		if err := m.evictIfNeeded(); err != nil {
306			m.mu.Unlock()
307			return "", noop, err
308		}
309	
310		// Re-check: another goroutine may have loaded this model while we evicted.
311		if ps2, ok := m.procs[modelName]; ok {
312			ps2.mu.Lock()
313			state2 := ps2.state
314			ready2 := ps2.ready
315			port2 := ps2.port
316			ps2.mu.Unlock()
317			switch state2 {
318			case stateLoaded:
319				ps2.inflight.Add(1)
320				ps2.mu.Lock()
321				ps2.lastUsed = time.Now()
322				ps2.mu.Unlock()
323				m.mu.Unlock()
324				return fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d", port2), func() { ps2.inflight.Add(-1) }, nil
325			case stateLoading:
326				m.mu.Unlock()
327				select {
328				case <-ready2:
329				case <-ctx.Done():
330					return "", noop, ctx.Err()
331				}
332				return m.checkLoaded(modelName)
333			}
334		}
335	
336		// Create a new procState and start the supervisor.
337		modelCtx, modelCancel := context.WithCancel(m.ctx)
338		ps := &procState{
339			modelName: modelName,
340			params:    params,
341			state:     stateLoading,
342			ready:     make(chan struct{}),
343			cancel:    modelCancel,
344			isWarmup:  false,
345		}
346		m.procs[modelName] = ps
347		ready := ps.ready
348		m.mu.Unlock()
349	
350		m.publishEvent(monitor.ServerEvent{
351			Time:    time.Now(),
352			Backend: modelName,
353			Kind:    monitor.EventModelLoad,
354			Message: "loading on demand",
355		})
356	
357		m.wg.Add(1)
358		ps.wg.Add(1)
359		go m.supervise(modelCtx, modelName)
360	
361		select {
362		case <-ready:
363		case <-ctx.Done():
364			return "", noop, ctx.Err()
365		}
366	
367		return m.checkLoaded(modelName)
368	}

370	// checkLoaded reads the outcome of a completed load (after ready has closed).
371	func (m *Manager) checkLoaded(modelName string) (addr string, release func(), err error) {
372		noop := func() {}
373	
374		m.mu.RLock()
375		ps, ok := m.procs[modelName]
376		m.mu.RUnlock()
377	
378		if !ok {
379			return "", noop, fmt.Errorf("model %q load failed", modelName)
380		}
381	
382		ps.mu.Lock()
383		state := ps.state
384		loadErr := ps.loadErr
385		port := ps.port
386		ps.mu.Unlock()
387	
388		if state != stateLoaded {
389			if loadErr != nil {
390				return "", noop, fmt.Errorf("model %q load failed: %w", modelName, loadErr)
391			}
392			return "", noop, fmt.Errorf("model %q load failed", modelName)
393		}
394	
395		ps.inflight.Add(1)
396		ps.mu.Lock()
397		ps.lastUsed = time.Now()
398		ps.mu.Unlock()
399		return fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d", port), func() { ps.inflight.Add(-1) }, nil
400	}

402	// evictIfNeeded evicts the LRU idle healthy model if we are at capacity.
403	//
404	// IMPORTANT: must be called with m.mu write-locked. It temporarily releases
405	// and re-acquires m.mu while waiting for the evicted supervisor to exit,
406	// so the caller must re-validate procs state after it returns.
407	func (m *Manager) evictIfNeeded() error {
408		// Count non-idle models.
409		running := 0
410		for _, ps := range m.procs {
411			ps.mu.Lock()
412			s := ps.state
413			ps.mu.Unlock()
414			if s != stateIdle {
415				running++
416			}
417		}
418		if running < m.cfg.MaxModels {
419			return nil
420		}
421	
422		// Find LRU healthy model with no in-flight requests.
423		type candidate struct {
424			name     string
425			ps       *procState
426			lastUsed time.Time
427		}
428		var candidates []candidate
429		for name, ps := range m.procs {
430			ps.mu.Lock()
431			state := ps.state
432			lu := ps.lastUsed
433			ps.mu.Unlock()
434			if state == stateLoaded && ps.inflight.Load() == 0 {
435				candidates = append(candidates, candidate{name: name, ps: ps, lastUsed: lu})
436			}
437		}
438		if len(candidates) == 0 {
439			return fmt.Errorf("at capacity (%d/%d models); all models have in-flight requests", running, m.cfg.MaxModels)
440		}
441	
442		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool {
443			return candidates[i].lastUsed.Before(candidates[j].lastUsed)
444		})
445	
446		victim := candidates[0]
447		victim.ps.mu.Lock()
448		victim.ps.state = stateUnloading
449		victim.ps.mu.Unlock()
450	
451		// Release the manager lock while waiting for the supervisor to exit.
452		m.mu.Unlock()
453	
454		m.log.Info("evicting model (LRU)", "model", victim.name)
455		m.publishEvent(monitor.ServerEvent{
456			Time:    time.Now(),
457			Backend: victim.name,
458			Kind:    monitor.EventModelLoad,
459			Message: "unloading (LRU eviction)",
460		})
461	
462		victim.ps.cancel()  // SIGTERM via context cancellation
463		victim.ps.wg.Wait() // wait for supervisor goroutine to exit
464	
465		m.mu.Lock() // re-acquire for the caller
466		delete(m.procs, victim.name)
467		return nil
468	}

486	// supervise is the per-model restart loop. It runs until ctx is cancelled
487	// or (for on-demand models) until the first load attempt fails or the process
488	// exits after becoming healthy.
489	func (m *Manager) supervise(ctx context.Context, modelName string) {
490		defer m.wg.Done()
491	
492		m.mu.RLock()
493		ps := m.procs[modelName]
494		m.mu.RUnlock()
495	
496		// Ensure state is idle and the ready channel is closed on exit (for any
497		// reason). This unblocks callers waiting in LoadOrGet and lets Loaded()
498		// return false after the supervisor exits.
499		defer func() {
500			ps.wg.Done()
501			ps.mu.Lock()
502			ready := ps.ready
503			ps.ready = nil
504			// Only preserve stateUnloading; evictIfNeeded owns that transition.
505			if ps.state != stateUnloading {
506				ps.state = stateIdle
507			}
508			ps.mu.Unlock()
509			if ready != nil {
510				close(ready)
511			}
512		}()
513	
514		const (
515			maxRetries  = 5
516			retryWindow = 60 * time.Second
517			backoff     = 2 * time.Second
518		)
519	
520		var (
521			attempts    int
522			windowStart = time.Now()
523			firstLoad   = true
524		)
525	
526		for {
527			select {
528			case <-ctx.Done():
529				return
530			default:
531			}
532	
533			if time.Since(windowStart) > retryWindow {
534				attempts = 0
535				windowStart = time.Now()
536			}
537			if attempts >= maxRetries {
538				m.log.Error("max restart retries exceeded, giving up", "model", modelName)
539				return
540			}
541	
542			if attempts > 0 && ps.isWarmup {
543				// Before retrying a warmup model, create a fresh ready channel so
544				// new callers waiting in LoadOrGet see the correct loading state.
545				ps.mu.Lock()
546				ps.state = stateLoading
547				ps.loadErr = nil
548				ps.ready = make(chan struct{})
549				ps.mu.Unlock()
550	
551				m.log.Info("restarting model", "model", modelName, "attempt", attempts)
552				select {
553				case <-ctx.Done():
554					return
555				case <-time.After(backoff):
556				}
557			}
558	
559			attempts++
560	
561			ps.mu.Lock()
562			if !firstLoad {
563				ps.restarts++
564			}
565			ps.startedAt = time.Now()
566			params := ps.params
567			ps.mu.Unlock()
568	
569			cmd, parser, err := m.launch(ctx, modelName, params)
570			if err != nil {
571				m.log.Error("failed to launch llama-server", "model", modelName, "error", err)
572				if !ps.isWarmup {
573					m.failLoad(ps, modelName, err)
574					return
575				}
576				continue
577			}
578	
579			// Wait for llama-server to report its listening port via stdout.
580			var port int
581			select {
582			case port = <-parser.PortCh:
583			case <-ctx.Done():
584				cmd.Process.Kill()
585				cmd.Wait() //nolint:errcheck
586				return
587			case <-time.After(m.effectiveHealthTimeout()):
588				m.log.Error("timed out waiting for listening port", "model", modelName)
589				cmd.Process.Kill()
590				cmd.Wait() //nolint:errcheck
591				if !ps.isWarmup {
592					m.failLoad(ps, modelName, fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for listening port"))
593					return
594				}
595				continue
596			}
597	
598			ps.mu.Lock()
599			ps.port = port
600			ps.proc = cmd
601			ps.mu.Unlock()
602	
603			loadStart := time.Now()
604			if err := waitHealthy(ctx, port, m.effectiveHealthTimeout()); err != nil {
605				m.log.Error("health check failed on start", "model", modelName, "error", err)
606				cmd.Process.Kill()
607				cmd.Wait() //nolint:errcheck
608				ps.mu.Lock()
609				ps.proc = nil
610				ps.mu.Unlock()
611				if !ps.isWarmup {
612					m.failLoad(ps, modelName, err)
613					return
614				}
615				continue
616			}
617	
618			loadDur := time.Since(loadStart)
619	
620			// Transition to healthy and signal all waiters by closing ready.
621			ps.mu.Lock()
622			ps.state = stateLoaded
623			if firstLoad {
624				ps.lastUsed = time.Now()
625			}
626			ready := ps.ready
627			ps.ready = nil
628			ps.mu.Unlock()
629	
630			if ready != nil {
631				close(ready)
632			}
633			firstLoad = false
634	
635			m.log.Info("model healthy", "model", modelName, "port", port, "load_duration", loadDur)
636			m.publishEvent(monitor.ServerEvent{
637				Time:       time.Now(),
638				Backend:    modelName,
639				Kind:       monitor.EventModelLoad,
640				DurationMs: float64(loadDur.Milliseconds()),
641				Message:    "loaded",
642			})
643	
644			exitCh := make(chan error, 1)
645			go func() { exitCh <- cmd.Wait() }()
646	
647			select {
648			case <-ctx.Done():
649				<-exitCh
650				return
651	
652			case exitErr := <-exitCh:
653				ps.mu.Lock()
654				ps.state = stateIdle
655				ps.proc = nil
656				ps.mu.Unlock()
657	
658				if ctx.Err() != nil {
659					return
660				}
661	
662				if exitErr != nil {
663					if ee, ok := errors.AsType[*exec.ExitError](exitErr); ok {
664						m.log.Warn("process exited unexpectedly", "model", modelName, "exit_code", ee.ExitCode())
665					} else {
666						m.log.Warn("process exited unexpectedly", "model", modelName, "error", exitErr)
667					}
668				}
669	
670				if !ps.isWarmup {
671					// On-demand model crashed; remove and stop.
672					m.mu.Lock()
673					delete(m.procs, modelName)
674					m.mu.Unlock()
675					return
676				}
677			}
678			// Warmup model: fall through to retry loop.
679		}
680	}

693		ps.loadErr = err
694		ps.state = stateIdle
695		ready := ps.ready
696		ps.ready = nil

699		if ready != nil {
